results.text: Comparison of the pharmacokinetics of MR-107A-02, a novel fast-absorbing formulation of meloxicam, versus standard meloxicam reference: a phase I study. MR-107A-02 is a novel faster dissolving oral formulation of meloxicam to provide rapid absorption and faster onset of action in acute pain settings. This study compared the single-dose pharmacokinetics of MR-107A-02 tablets to reference meloxicam (Mobic®) tablets under fasting conditions. results.text: Comparison of Intravenous and Oral Meloxicam Pharmacokinetics in Female and Male Saanen Goats. This study aimed to investigate the effect of gender on the pharmacokinetics of meloxicam in goats following intravenous (IV, 0.5 mg/kg) and oral (PO, 1.0 mg/kg) administration. A crossover design was used with 12 clinically healthy Saanen goats (six females and six males).
